summary: Monte Rosa Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 furnishing a press release and webcast slides reporting positive topline GFORCE-1 Phase 1 results for MRT-8102, a NEK7-directed molecular glue degrader for NLRP3/IL-1-driven inflammatory disease. The 108-subject trial dosed obese subjects with elevated cardiovascular risk at 5 mg, 20 mg or 40 mg once daily versus placebo over four weeks with four weeks follow-up. No deal, stake, price or board recommendation is involved; this is routine clinical data disclosure, not a special situation.
